shortDescription.default: HR noticeboard for SharePoint, with PDF/image notices, OCR and a TV display

longDescription.default: Staffroom Gazette lets HR post notices (text, PDFs or images) to a SharePoint page. Text in PDFs is read automatically to suggest a headline, summary, category and take-down date; text in images is read with OCR and must be checked by HR before use. A TV display mode shows notices full screen.

features.title: Staffroom Gazette
features.description: Adds the Staffroom Gazette web part.
